words.definition: A motion like that of waves; a moving in this and that direction.
words.example: the fluctuations of the sea

words.definition: Characterized by exceptionally early development or maturity.
words.example: The precocious plant was already blooming flowers by day 4.

words.definition: One who uses words skillfully.
words.example: She has always been known as a capable wordsmith, but in this latest novel she also shows surprising emotional depth.

words.definition: To signify beyond its literal or principal meaning.
words.example: Racism often connotes an underlying fear or ignorance.

words.definition: A messenger, especially one bringing important news.
words.example: The herald blew his trumpet and shouted that the King was dead.

words.definition: A derogatory hint or reference to a person or thing. An implication, intimation or insinuation.
words.example: She made a devious innuendo about her husband, who was embarrassed.

words.definition: To remove the mystery from something; to explain or clarify.
words.example: The article was written to demystify the mechanics of the internal combustion engine.

words.definition: Habitually lazy, procrastinating, or resistant to physical labor
words.example: The indolent girl resisted doing her homework.

words.definition: A person who deviates, especially from norms of social behavior.
words.example: He was branded as a deviant and ostracized.

words.definition: Full of venom.
words.example: The villain tricked him into drinking the venomous concoction.

words.definition: The art of creating, arranging and recording the dance movements of a work, such as a ballet.
words.example: She has staged many successful ballets, so her choreography skills must be excellent.

words.definition: To honor; to hold in high esteem.
words.example: They exalted their queen.

words.definition: One fully skilled or well versed in anything; a proficient
words.example: adepts in philosophy

words.definition: Of or pertaining to meteorology.
words.example: The trip was postponed because the meteorological conditions were so bad.

words.definition: The edge, margin, or border of a steep place, as of a precipice; a bank or edge.
words.example: the brink of a river

words.definition: To stand about without any aim or purpose; to stand about idly.
words.example: For some reason, they discourage loitering outside the store, but encourage it inside.

words.definition: To push, throw over, overturn or overthrow something
words.example: The massed crowds toppled the statue of the former dictator.

words.definition: Proximity; the state of being near.
words.example: There was a crackling sound in the vicinity of my right ear.

words.definition: The receding movement of the tide.
words.example: The boats will go out on the ebb.

words.definition: Concerning or involving calamity, disastrous.
words.example: The city was struck by a calamitous cyclone.

words.definition: Grim or severe in manner or appearance
words.example: The headmistress was an austere old woman.

words.definition: The state or quality of being opaque, not allowing light to pass through
words.example: We could not see the sandbar due to the opacity of the muddy water.

words.definition: Shocking, horrifying.
words.example: The accident was described with lurid detail.

words.definition: A small part of something, such as a song or fabric; sample.
words.example: From the snippet I heard of their rehearsal, they sound pretty good.

words.definition: Objects that are designed to be short-lived.
words.example: vintage ephemera

words.definition: (manner) In a summary manner.
words.example: They were fired summarily at a single plant-wide meeting.

words.definition: To belittle or express disapproval of.
words.example: He deprecates any praise of his own merits.

words.definition: Understood by only a few.
words.example: arcane rituals

words.definition: Lying face downward.
words.example: prone position

words.definition: Any one of various common types of small insects or animals which cause harm and annoyance.
words.example: The area was plagued by all sorts of vermin: fleas, lice, mice, and rats to name a few.

words.definition: The endeavor or desire to equal or excel someone else in qualities or actions.
words.example: a great figure who is worthy of respect and emulation

words.definition: Powerful industrialist; captain of industry.
words.example: I have decided to become an oil magnate, after spending quite some time reading the dictionary definition of the word magnate.

words.definition: An extensive waste covered with patches of heath, and having a poor, light soil, but sometimes marshy, and abounding in peat; a heath
words.example: A cold, biting wind blew across the moor, and the travellers hastened their step.

words.definition: To stick fast or cleave, as a glutinous substance does; to become joined or united.
words.example: wax adhered to his finger

words.definition: To forbid or prohibit.
words.example: The law proscribes driving a car while intoxicated.

words.definition: An ungrateful person
words.example: 1843, But Mr Pecksniff, dismissing all ephemeral considerations of social pleasure and enjoyment, concentrated his meditations on the one great virtuous purpose before him, of casting out that ingrate and deceiver, whose presence yet troubled his domestic hearth, and was a sacrilege upon the altars of his household gods. — Charles Dickens, Martin Chuzzlewit

words.definition: Of an object: not strong or sturdy, as because of poor construction or upkeep; not safe or secure.
words.example: He hesitated about climbing such a small, rickety ladder.

words.definition: Perfect, without faults, flaws or errors
words.example: He grew up in Norway, but he writes impeccable English.

words.definition: The chance or random quality of an event or circumstance.
words.example: by happenstance

words.definition: To restore a friendly relationship; to bring back to harmony.
words.example: to reconcile people who have quarrelled

words.definition: The reestablishment of friendly relations; conciliation or rapprochement.
words.example: He longed for reconciliation with his estranged father, but too many painful memories kept him from making contact again.

words.definition: The quality of being genuine or not corrupted from the original.
words.example: I hereby certify the authenticity of this copy.

words.definition: To restore consciousness, vigor, or life to.
words.example: to resuscitate a drowned person; to resuscitate withered plants

words.definition: To form into a whole by uniting its parts; to construct; to build.
words.example: to fabricate a bridge or ship

words.definition: The act of fabricating, framing, or constructing; construction; manufacture
words.example: the fabrication of a bridge, a church, or a government

words.definition: To spread through or over something, especially as a liquid, colour or light; to bathe.
words.example: The entire room was suffused with a golden light.

words.definition: Showing contempt; expressing disdain; showing a lack of respect.
words.example: I don't know that guy, but he just gave me a contemptuous look.

words.definition: In a disrespectful or discourteous manner; condescendingly.
words.example: He argued with the judge contemptuously, showing no respect or remorse for his actions.

words.definition: Inconsistent with, or far removed from, something; strongly opposed
words.example: abhorrent thoughts

words.definition: The act of wandering; deviation from truth, moral rectitude; abnormal; divergence from the straight, correct, proper, normal, or from the natural state.
words.example: aberration of character

words.definition: A substance that helps an emulsion form, or helps keep an emulsion from separating.
words.example: The lecithin in egg yolks is often used as an emulsifier.

words.definition: A substance added to another substance or product to produce specific properties in the combined substance.
words.example: Oil may be used as an additive in gasoline to improve the lubrication of a small engine.

words.definition: A food item prepared very sweet, frequently decorated in fine detail, and often preserved with sugar, such as a candy, sweetmeat, fruit preserve, pastry, or cake.
words.example: The table was covered with all sorts of tempting confections.

words.definition: To make a false show or pretence of; to counterfeit or simulate.
words.example: The pupil feigned sickness on the day of his exam.

words.definition: The act of banishing.
words.example: The judge pronounced banishment upon the war criminal.

words.definition: The fulfillment of something worked for.
words.example: After six years of hard work, the engineers had brought the project to fruition.

words.definition: To impact directly, especially if violent.
words.example: When a body collides with another, then momentum is conserved.

words.definition: Lacking a definite form or clear shape.
words.example: The enormous pile of spaghetti landed on the floor in an amorphous heap.

words.definition: True; genuine.
words.example: He is a veritable genius.

words.definition: A superficial or shallow knowledge of a subject.
words.example: She knows a smattering of Greek, but not enough to carry on a conversation.

words.definition: Having the faculty of quick motion in the limbs; apt or ready to move
words.example: an agile creature

words.definition: The quality of being agile; the power of moving the limbs quickly and easily; quickness of motion
words.example: His superior agility countered his lack of strength.

words.definition: Terrified; struck with amazement; showing signs of terror or horror.
words.example: I was aghast when the incident unfolded in front of me.

words.definition: Full of rapture.
words.example: the rapturous emotions on the pulpit

words.definition: Needing or using up much energy; testing powers of endurance.
words.example: The movement towards a peaceful settlement has been a long and arduous political struggle.

words.definition: To chew cud. (Said of ruminants.) Involves regurgitating partially digested food from the rumen.
words.example: A camel will ruminate just as a cow will.

words.definition: To represent in a physical or concrete form; to incarnate or personify.
words.example: As the car salesman approached, wearing a plaid suit and slicked-back hair, he seemed to embody sleaze.

words.definition: Full of longing or yearning.
words.example: His eyes grew wistful as he recalled his university days.

words.definition: Financial support or assistance, such as a grant.
words.example: Manufacturing firms are supported by government subsidies in some countries.

words.definition: A period of something, usually painful or unpleasant.
words.example: a bout of drought.

words.definition: Expressed in silence; implied, but not made explicit; silent.
words.example: tacit consent : consent by silence, or by not raising an objection

words.definition: Silent; temperamentally untalkative; disinclined to speak.
words.example: The two sisters could hardly have been more different, one so boisterous and expressive, the other so taciturn and calm.

words.definition: Full of seeds.
words.example: Pomegranates are as seedy as any fruit you are likely to see.

words.definition: Inflicting punishment, punishing
words.example: The jury awarded $10,000 in punitive damages.

words.definition: (grammar) An attributive word or phrase (see above), contrasted with predicative or substantive.
words.example: In "this big house," "big" is an attributive, while in "this house is big," it is a predicative.

words.definition: Responsible travel to natural areas supporting the fauna, flora, and local economy
words.example: Ecotourism serves the environment and improves the well-being of indigenous peoples, too.

words.definition: A violent oscillation or vibration.
words.example: The discomfort caused by the bat's reverberation surprised Tommy.

words.definition: (of a person) Feeling or filled with remorse.
words.example: He was so remorseful that he voluntarily paid full restitution.

words.definition: In an inexorable manner; without the possibility of stopping or prevention.
words.example: We watched as the storm clouds advanced inexorably closer to us.
